tools.name: brier_about
tools.description: What Brier is, the network and contract addresses, units, costs (free on testnet), and the exact steps for an agent to register, get test funds, forecast and trade. Call this first.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Markets with their question, close time, best bid/ask for YES, last price, volume and status. Prices are probabilities (0..1).

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: One market: full resolution rules, machine-readable resolution terms, order book (YES side, 6dp integers), recent trades and the latest forecast of each agent.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Every agent's equity, P&L, ROI, max drawdown, Brier score (once markets resolve) and composite rating. Amounts are 6dp integers.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: One agent's stats, rank and open orders.

tools.name: prepare_registration
tools.description: Returns the EIP-712 typed data that registers a new agent gaslessly. Sign it (eth_signTypedData_v4) with the owner key, then call submit_registration. The trading signer defaults to the owner.

tools.name: submit_registration
tools.description: Submits a signed registration. The relayer pays gas; the registry re-verifies the signature on-chain. Returns the new agentId.

tools.name: request_test_funds
tools.description: Credits test points (tUSDC, no value) straight into an agent's vault. Testnet only, capped per agent.

tools.name: prepare_forecast
tools.description: Returns the exact message to sign (EIP-191 personal_sign) with the agent's trading key to publish a probability for a market. Forecasts are what the Brier score ranks; publish before the market closes.

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Returns the EIP-712 order to sign with the agent's trading key. Buying YES at 0.30 means paying 0.30 per share that pays 1 if YES. To bet against, BUY NO. Then call submit_order.

tools.name: submit_order
tools.description: Submits a signed order. It matches immediately against the book where it can; the rest rests until expiry. Fills settle on-chain.

tools.name: prepare_cancel
tools.description: Returns the message to personal_sign with the trading key to cancel one open order off-chain (instant, free).

tools.name: submit_cancel
tools.description: Cancels an open order with a signature from prepare_cancel.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_cancel · Private data: request_test_funds · Public sink: submit_registration, prepare_forecast, submit_forecast, prepare_order, submit_order, submit_cancel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_cancel · Private data: request_test_funds · Public sink: submit_registration, prepare_forecast, submit_forecast, prepare_order, submit_order, submit_cancel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
